**Principal Back\-End CAD Engineer – Physical Implementation \& AI, Austin, Texas**
 This is an on\-site, hybrid work schedule.
   

  

**This is not a remote work opportunity.**
**About The Role**
 As part of PEU Silicon and the Silicon CAD group, we are building the next generation of silicon development infrastructure and methodologies that power our ASIC roadmap.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced Back\-End CAD engineer who combines deep Physical Design expertise with a passion for automation, methodology development, and AI\-driven innovation.
   

  

 This role goes far beyond traditional CAD support. You will own and evolve our Back\-End implementation framework, FlowJam, working directly with Physical Design teams to deliver industry\-leading Power, Performance, Area, and Productivity across multiple ASIC programs.
   

  

 You will help define how future physical implementation is performed—from advanced\-node synthesis and place\-and\-route methodologies to AI\-assisted design optimization and next\-generation CAD infrastructure.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving hard problems, building scalable engineering platforms, and influencing the future of silicon development, we'd like to talk.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead the architecture, development, and evolution of FlowJam, our Back\-End CAD flow framework.
* Partner closely with Physical Design teams to drive implementation methodology and execution across multiple ASIC programs.
* Develop and optimize synthesis, place\-and\-route, timing closure, power optimization, and signoff methodologies for advanced technology nodes.
* Drive continuous improvements in QoR, runtime, scalability, and engineering productivity.
* Define reusable methodologies and automation frameworks that accelerate project execution.
* Evaluate and deploy next\-generation EDA capabilities across both Synopsys and Cadence tool ecosystems.
* Collaborate with EDA vendors to drive methodology improvements, debug tool issues, and influence future capabilities.
* Explore and integrate AI technologies that improve implementation, design\-space exploration, closure, debug, and engineering efficiency.
* Help define the long\-term roadmap for Back\-End CAD and physical implementation within PEU Silicon.
* Mentor engineers and help build a culture of technical excellence and execution.


**What You Bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in Physical Design, Back\-End CAD, or Physical Implementation Methodology.
* Deep expertise in synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock\-tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, and power optimization.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Synopsys Fusion Compiler and/or Cadence Innovus.
* Proven experience developing and deploying methodologies on advanced technology nodes.
* Strong understanding of complete RTL\-to\-GDS implementation flows.
* Expertise in Python, Tcl, and automation framework development.
* Experience driving methodology improvements across multiple projects and engineering teams.
* Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence engineers, project teams, and EDA vendors.
* Curiosity about how AI will transform silicon development and enthusiasm for building the next generation of engineering workflows.
